privacy_note: Paraphrased development scenario. No account identity, deck identifiers, private deck list, or verbatim user conversation. Reference snippets are frozen supplied evidence, not live corpus claims.

context.note: Seven open slots is capacity, not a request for seven recommendations or cuts.

references.Marchesa, the Black Rose: Other creatures you control have dethrone. Whenever a creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it dies, return that card to the battlefield under your control at the beginning of the next end step.
references.Teval's Judgment: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn — Draw a card; create a Treasure token; or create a 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature token.
references.Yawgmoth, Thran Physician: Pay 1 life, Sacrifice another creature: Put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature and draw a card. {B}{B}, Discard a card: Proliferate.
references.Elegy Acolyte: Lifelink. Whenever one or more creatures you control deal combat damage to a player, you draw a card and lose 1 life. Void — At the beginning of your end step, if a nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn or a spell was warped this turn, create a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token.

cases.prompt: I have seven open slots in a Marchesa deck. Suggest two useful lists: broadly strong draw engines, and draw cards that fit sacrificing and recurring creatures. Rhystic Study and Mystic Remora are examples, not the whole first list.

semantic_criteria.list_breadth: Both lists contain useful new draw candidates, not merely repeated examples or non-draw support cards.
semantic_criteria.functional_relevance: Synergy candidates actually generate draw; explain concrete Marchesa fit and distinguish existing cards.
semantic_criteria.teval_continuity: Recognize the canonical Teval's Judgment and explain its draw-mode once-per-turn limit when comparing it.

cases.prompt: Prioritize late-game draw density and cards with several useful roles. I prefer draw I can choose to use. Compare your options with what we already know; I do not need cuts.

semantic_criteria.voluntary_activation: Distinguish voluntarily activating Yawgmoth from mandatory drawing during resolution; do not reject solely because it lacks may.
semantic_criteria.conditions_costs: Compare mana/life/sacrifice costs, recurring versus one-shot draw and realistic enabling conditions.
semantic_criteria.retained_evidence: Do not deny already retrieved Teval evidence; do not require seven additions or cuts.

cases.prompt: Keep recommendations to creatures. Six mana is more than I want to spend on Harvester of Souls. What do you think of Elegy Acolyte for draw and multiple roles in this deck?

semantic_criteria.direct_answer: Give substantive Elegy assessment before further discovery, even when the tool budget is exhausted.
semantic_criteria.elegy_facts: Combat-dependent mandatory draw with life loss, conditional Robot production, lifelink; do not describe it as a death-draw trigger.
semantic_criteria.marchesa_fit: Discuss sacrifice support for Void, token limits on recurring graveyard return, and life-total tension with dethrone where relevant.
semantic_criteria.preference_memory: Retain late-game draw, multiple roles and optionality preference, enforce creatures and respect Harvester rejection without inventing a hard mana ceiling.
